task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to doublecheck that the Canadian locker is unlocked. After unlocking the Canadian locker, doublecheck that the Canadian locker within the studio is wide open. Then, pick up the keycard from the Canadian locker. And then, unlock the portal. Then, assure that the portal within the studio is wide open. After opening the portal, go to the south. After that, head south. After that, venture west. Next, try to head west. Then, attempt to take a trip south. With that accomplished, pick up the manuscript from the floor of the bedchamber. Once that's all handled, you can stop!

You find yourself in a studio. A standard one.

You see a Canadian locker. Huh, weird.

There is a closed portal leading south. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unguarded.

thought: I should check if the Canadian locker is unlocked first.
